description:
Non-Material Amendment to planning permission reference 260826 granted 24/06/2026 for an amendment to the description of development to accurately reflect the approved/proposed works and associated layout, together with the
substitution of the previously specified external air-conditioning unit (ACU) with a revised model. The location of the external ACU remains
unchanged. Revised plans are submitted to reflect the correct layout and to identify the dimensions of the proposed ACU and air source heat
pump (ASHP). The new description should read ""Construction of a single storey wraparound 
rear extension, replacement of existing roof and installation of four photovoltaic panels on the main roof and one roof light. Together with 
installation of air source heat pump and air conditioning unit within the rear garden."
